# Force-Velocity Profiling In Resistance Training

This rights-cleared source characterizes the force-velocity relationship of
maximal muscle contractions. It reports how load-velocity profiles predict
power-output across the spectrum from heavy strength loads to ballistic speed
loads, and how rate-of-force-development shifts with training emphasis.

Force-velocity profiling lets a coach place an athlete on the force-velocity
continuum and prescribe load-velocity zones that maximize power-output for the
individual, including contractile-velocity deficits.
